questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2010, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Florida State 23, Florida 19 (through 2025). Latest: Florida State: 2023 vs. No. 16 Duke 38–20, 2023 vs. No. 15 Louisville 16–6, 2025 vs. No. 8 Alabama 31–17; Florida: 2024 vs. No. 21 LSU 27–16, 2024 vs. No. 9 Ole Miss 24–17, 2025 vs. No. 9 Texas 29–21.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.

questions.label: Rankings
questions.prompt: Of the 25 Florida–Florida State games from 2000 through 2025, how many featured a team ranked No. 1 in the AP poll?
questions.reveal: 2: 2009 (No. 1 Florida 37, Florida State 10) · 2014 (No. 1 Florida State 24, Florida 19).

info.title: Which poll?
info.text: The AP Top 25 in force the week of each game; bowl and championship games use the last regular-season poll. Tied teams share a rank.
